title: Step-by-step explainer (Canvas)
description: An animated process explainer: the title rises in with an accent rule, numbered nodes pop in on a connector that draws itself, each step slides in with an optional note, finished steps dim and turn into check marks, and a closing beat recaps every step. Portrait stacks the title above the steps; landscape sets them side by side.

title.default: How a blueprint becomes a video
title.description: Title above or beside the steps

steps.description: Step labels in order, a short imperative each

notes.description: Optional one-line detail under each step (same order; empty string for none)

palette.description: Ground, ink, accent and muted (notes, track) colours

grid.description: Opacity of the drifting dot grid

recap.description: End with every step lit and checked

notes: Needs `pip install playwright` and `playwright install chromium-headless-shell`.
Uses the system's Inter (fonts-inter) when installed, else Helvetica Neue/Arial.
